name: craft-proof
description: Makes Claude prove its work, for code and any deliverable: a contract of user-visible claims before changing code or writing a document, each with evidence the hooks re-check (a command whose real result is recorded, a quoted source, a recomputed number, file contents, or a judged rubric), read-only existing tests, and no finishing until every claim is proven or named as unverified. Carries the fifteen craft skills plus a contract skill, and the hooks point to the skill that fits.
